label: TP
reason: Assessed alert path: user input from request.getParameter flows through bar variable to response.getWriter().write(bar.toCharArray(),...). While the code applies a transformation (replacing last character with "Z" when param.length()>1), this is incomplete XSS mitigation - payloads like <script>...</script> would still render with trailing Z (<script>...</scriZ>) allowing XSS execution. Attacker-controlled data reaches the sink expression.

evidence.note: User input from getParameter flows to bar, then to writer.write(bar.toCharArray()). Transformation only changes last char, not sufficient XSS prevention
